runtimes.value: PaddleOCR package (paddleocr[doc-parser] >= 3.4) with backend mlx-vlm-server (mlx-vlm >= 0.3.11; official Apple Silicon guide, verified on M4); mlx-vlm with mlx-community builds (PaddleOCR-VL 4-8 bit, bf16; also 1.5); llama.cpp llama-server + mmproj (support PR #18825 covers 0.9B and 1.5; official GGUF for 1.5/1.6); transformers element-level only. Ollama: community tags only (MedAIBase/PaddleOCR-VL)
runtimes.note: The official Apple Silicon guide now uses PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 as its example; running the original 0.9B the same way is likely but unverified. Native PaddlePaddle inference on macOS not checked (cards point Mac users to Docker or MLX).

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026. Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, issues of Ollama, QwenLM, resemble-ai/chatterbox and mlx-audio (now `Neywa-Labs/mlx-audio`). **Reddit could not be read.** Items from before 13.05.2026 that are not launch discussions are marked "older". 1.0 released 16.10.2025, 1.6 released 27.05.2026. **Feedback thin.**
web.summary: Few reports; prefer version 1.6 over 1.0; nothing on French or German.
web.verdict: Thin feedback; MLX build used on Mac; repetition loops; prefer 1.6

comments.text: 1.0 repeats tokens forever on some forms ([HF #73, 03.03.2026, older](https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR-VL/discussions/73)).

Used on Mac as an MLX 8-bit build ([dandaka, 21.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49387167)); good experiences with MinerU and PaddleOCR-VL ([dcan, 14.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49298968)).
